pricing._readme: Approved by Tomas 2026-09-09. Amounts in CZK excluding VAT. reference_rate_czk_hour is the sanity check the bands were set against, not a formula that reproduces them: implied_hours records what each band's entry price buys at that rate. Never publish a band that is not listed here.

bands.includes_cs: Funkční pilot v provozu: přihlášení, databáze, jedna až dvě integrace, testy, nasazení.
bands.includes_en: A working pilot in production: authentication, database, one or two integrations, tests, deployment.

bands.includes_cs: Role a oprávnění, platby, administrace, více integrací, e2e testy, CI a monitoring.
bands.includes_en: Roles and permissions, payments, admin, multiple integrations, e2e tests, CI and monitoring.

bands.includes_cs: Napojení modelu na firemní data, kontrola kvality odpovědí, transparenční vrstva. On-premise nasazení začíná výš kvůli hardwaru a provozu; hardware není v ceně.
bands.includes_en: Connecting a model to company data, answer-quality controls and a transparency layer. On-premise deployment starts higher because of hardware and operations; hardware is not included.

discovery.cs: Placené discovery za 25 000 Kč — zadání, architektura a odhad. Částka se odečítá z ceny navazujícího projektu.
discovery.en: A paid discovery for 25,000 CZK — scope, architecture and estimate. The fee is deducted from the price of the follow-up project.
